header.title: Questions before you book?
header.subtitle: The essentials on authorized schools, free booking, availability, safety and cancellations.

scope.q: What can I book through DriveLinkUp?
scope.a: Browse authorized driving schools in Sweden for licence categories such as AM, A1, A2, A, B and BE. Each listing shows its categories, published price, availability and booking mode.

choose.q: How do I choose a driving school?
choose.a: Use the filters for category, city, language, availability and maximum price. Compare each school's published details, open slots, booking mode and cancellation tier before booking.

booking.a: Choose an open school slot and complete the short booking form. Instant booking moves you to hosted checkout; request-to-book sends the school a request first, and payment comes after acceptance.

price.a: You see the school's published lesson price and the total in SEK before checkout. Discovery, comparison and booking are free for learners: DriveLinkUp adds no separate learner fee.

safety.q: What safety and credential checks should I expect?
safety.a: Authorized schools are responsible for the credentials and lesson setup they publish. Review each listing and confirm any remaining questions before you start. Swedish handledare are a separate private-supervisor path with their own legal requirements; they are not driving schools.

cancellation.q: How do cancellations and refunds work?
cancellation.a: The school chooses one policy tier, shown before you book and saved on the booking. Flexible: full refund at least 24 hours before, full lesson fee within 24 hours. Moderate: full refund at least 120 hours before, 50% fee from 120 to 24 hours, full fee within 24 hours. Strict: full refund at least 168 hours before, 50% fee from 168 to 24 hours, full fee within 24 hours.

prerequisites.q: What do I need before a lesson?
prerequisites.a: Check the requirements for your licence category and the school's instructions before meeting. For supervised practice driving, the learner and supervisor must meet the applicable Swedish requirements. Ask the school if you are unsure about documents, vehicle or lesson preparation.

clickwrap.stepLead: As a handledare you sit alongside a learner during supervised practice driving. Read the terms below, then tick the box to confirm you meet the requirements.

bodyParagraphs.0: DriveLinkUp connects learners and handledare — the marketplace itself. We do not arrange insurance, supervise the sessions, or carry liability for what happens at the wheel. By ticking the box below you confirm that your motor insurance covers supervised practice driving (övningskörning) with a learner driver, and that you have evidence of it (your insurer's confirmation or the policy schedule).
bodyParagraphs.1: Liability for supervised sessions rests with you and the learner during those sessions. DriveLinkUp is not a party to the arrangement between handledare and learner, and our marketplace role ends once the session is agreed and held. If an incident occurs, the involved parties' insurance — not the marketplace — is the right first conversation.
bodyParagraphs.2: These terms may be updated from time to time. When we change them materially we'll reach out and ask you to re-attest. A record of every acceptance — including the version of the terms you accepted and the date — is stored against your account. This is placeholder text; the founding team will replace it with lawyer-reviewed copy.

bodyParagraphs.1: Liability for supervised sessions rests with you and the learner during those sessions. DriveLinkUp is not a party to the arrangement between handledare and learner, and our marketplace role ends once the session is agreed and held. If an incident occurs, the involved parties' insurance — not the marketplace — is the right first conversation.
bodyParagraphs.2: These terms may be updated from time to time. When we change them materially we'll reach out and ask you to re-attest. A record of every acceptance — including the version of the terms you accepted and the date — is stored against your account. This is placeholder text; the founding team will replace it with lawyer-reviewed copy.

meta.title: Privacy policy | DriveLinkUp
meta.description: How DriveLinkUp processes personal data for accounts, bookings, payments, school credentials and safety.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.intro: This policy explains how DriveLinkUp processes personal data when you browse school listings, create an account, book a lesson or join as a school or handledare.
hero.reviewNotice: Legal review note: this customer-facing draft should be reviewed and completed by DriveLinkUp's legal adviser before publication.

0.title: 1. Controller and contact
0.body: DriveLinkUp is the controller for the personal data described here. For privacy questions or requests, email support@drivelinkup.com with “Privacy” in the subject line.

1.title: 2. Data we collect
1.body: Depending on how you use the service, we may process:
items: Account data such as name, email address, sign-in credentials and account role.
Profile data such as city, languages, licence categories, profile photo, lesson price and biography.
Booking data such as selected school, category, slot, booking status, cancellation policy and support correspondence.
Payment data and transaction status processed through the hosted payment provider. Card details are handled by that provider rather than stored by DriveLinkUp.
School credential, licence, insurance and onboarding information submitted for the school or handledare account.
Technical data such as IP address, browser information, device information and consent preferences.
Messages or contact details you choose to send to support.

2.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
2.body: We use personal data only for the purposes needed to provide, secure and improve the service. The applicable basis may be performance of a contract, legitimate interests, consent or compliance with a legal obligation.
items: To create and manage accounts and school or handledare profiles.
To show school listings, availability, pricing and booking policies to people who are deciding whether to book.
To create bookings, send transactional messages and provide support.
To process payments, refunds and payment-related records through our payment provider.
To review school credentials and safety information submitted during onboarding.
To protect the service, prevent abuse and meet accounting or other legal duties.

3.title: 4. Retention
3.body: We keep data only for as long as needed for the purpose collected, to resolve disputes, meet legal duties and enforce our agreements. Exact periods depend on the data type and the applicable legal obligation.
items: Account and profile data is kept while the account is active and for a limited period afterward for security and support.
Booking, payment and accounting records may be retained for the period required by Swedish law.
Credential and insurance material is retained only as long as needed for onboarding, review, safety and legal obligations.
Support messages and technical logs are retained for a limited period appropriate to the case or security purpose.

4.title: 5. Sharing and processors
4.body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers and authorities where needed to operate the service, process a payment, support a booking, protect users or comply with law.
items: Hosted payment processors, including Stripe, handle checkout and payment-related processing.
Cloud storage providers may host profile images or provider documents submitted to the service.
Email, authentication, hosting and monitoring providers help deliver messages, secure accounts and operate the site.
Authorities, advisers or other recipients may receive data where required by law or needed to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

5.title: 6. International transfers
5.body: Some processors may process data outside the EU/EEA. Where required, DriveLinkUp will use an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses or another lawful safeguard and make relevant information available on request.

6.title: 7. Your rights
6.body: Subject to the conditions in GDPR, you may request:
items: Access to your personal data.
Correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Deletion, restriction or objection where the legal conditions are met.
Data portability for data processed by automated means on the basis of consent or contract.
Withdrawal of consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
A complaint to the relevant supervisory authority; in Sweden, Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (IMY).

7.title: 8. Cookies
7.body: DriveLinkUp uses necessary cookies for authentication, language and security. Optional analytics or marketing cookies are used only where required consent has been given. You can manage consent through the cookie controls provided on the site.

8.title: 9. Changes and contact
8.body: We may update this policy when the service, law or processing changes. The latest version and date appear above. For questions or a rights request, contact support@drivelinkup.com.

notes.title: First-market booking and commission rules (Sweden)
notes.body: A booking is attributable when the learner completes it through DriveLinkUp. Commission is 10% of that attributable booking value and is due only after completed service—not for browsing, registration, or an uncompleted enquiry. Cancellation, refund and no-show outcomes follow the school’s published policy and the booking record. Learners never pay a separate DriveLinkUp fee; the school’s published price stays the learner total. Settlement timing and payout responsibilities are confirmed per participating school before live transactions are promoted.

meta.title: Handledare and private practice driving | DriveLinkUp
meta.description: Understand the Swedish handledare path and how it differs from authorized driving-school listings.

handledareInfo.title: Handledare are a separate private path.
handledareInfo.lead: In Sweden, a handledare supports private övningskörning under the applicable rules. This is different from booking an authorized driving school through DriveLinkUp.

private.title: Private övningskörning
private.body: Learners and handledare must meet the current Swedish requirements, permissions and vehicle rules. Check Transportstyrelsen guidance before practice. DriveLinkUp does not present handledare as authorized schools.

schools.title: Authorized driving schools
schools.body: For professional lessons, use the marketplace to compare authorized-school listings, published prices and availability. Learner discovery, comparison and booking have no separate DriveLinkUp fee.
